title: Final Answer Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field outside the sphere must be correctly stated as E = Q/(4 pi epsilon_0 r^2).

title: Final Answer Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field inside the sphere must be correctly stated as E = Qr/(4 pi epsilon_0 R^3).

title: Charge Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The volume charge density must be correctly calculated as rho = Q/(4/3 pi R^3).

title: Application of Gauss's Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of Gauss's law must be correctly shown, including the integral setup.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning about the symmetry of the electric field must be clearly articulated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the electric field should be checked for consistency throughout the solution.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the final expressions for the electric field will lead to a deduction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors such as 4 pi in the electric field equations will result in a deduction.
